**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update the Python alias fixture for Windows native resolution**

On Windows runners where symlink creation succeeds, this extension-only lookup makes the existing `python_alias_behavior_test` fail: `ops/cong_cu_test.py:3126–3148` creates only an extensionless `python3` symlink and replaces PATH with that directory, so the new resolver returns no interpreter and the probe exits 3 instead of 0. This precheck runs before the suite, and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` invokes it in both `gate` and `gate-cong-cu`, breaking those Windows lanes. Update the fixture alongside this behavior change to provide a Windows-runnable `python3.cmd` or equivalent; retain the intended native-resolution rule.
